TODAY'S RULING: COUNSEL ARE TO DRAFT A MUTUAL STATEMENT THAT CONFORMS TO THE LAW THAT WOULD GIVE PETITIONER ACCESS TO THE RECORDS; PETITIONER WOULD AGREE NOT TO USE THOSE RECORDS IN ANY WAY THAT WOULD BE HOSTILE TO RESPONDENT.
